rationale: RCL gapped up ~6.9% on no news catalyst visible in the last 24 hours, opened at $300 and has already faded from the session high of $308.45 down to $298.58, now trading below VWAP ($301.22) and below the 9-EMA ($299.42), sitting at only 21.6% of today's range.
